commentary.text: Training evidence is highly concentrated in RPM 1000-1200 / MAP 45-50 kPa with sparse support elsewhere; frozen fit produced 4 accepted, 1 suppressed, 251 unsupported cells; holdout paired prediction on 3780 rows shows conditional predicted deltas only, not measured improvement and no ECU-write authorization.

Coverage is narrow: 5 supported of 256 VE cells, large exclusions, one suppressed below-minimum cell, many holdout neighborhoods unassessed or with single-digit rows; statistics use equal weights with correlated samples, AFR delay fixed at zero, fuel assumed proportional to VE, calibration association caller-supplied.

Unverified hypothesis: observed mean/median AFR errors may be consistent with localized fueling offsets interacting with closed-loop, sensor bias, or unmodeled transients, but numerical facts do not prove engine causality and require independent measurement.

limitations: Numerical statements are server-rendered; model commentary is unverified and does not establish engine causes.
Predicted AFR and metric changes assume proportional fueling and unchanged other factors. AFR delay compensation is unimplemented at 0 ms; improvements are not measured.
Unsupported, unidentifiable and unstable cells remain unchanged. Calibration association and active ECU table behavior require caller confirmation.
Only frozen training data determine fitting. Holdout results do not select parameters, masks, profiles or a winning candidate.
This advisory report cannot authorize ECU writes or automatic application of calibration changes.
Full evidence is retained in a private, expiring server run. It becomes unavailable after disposal, timeout or worker failure.

limitations: Errors are measured AFR minus interpolated calibration target; they are not VE corrections or predicted improvements.
Calibration semantics must be explicitly bound by the caller; imported axis names alone do not prove MAP kPa or AFR units.
Only eligible rows with valid targets and in-bounds VE neighborhoods contribute. Diagnostic errors on other rows are not aggregate evidence.
AFR sensor/transport delay is unimplemented and fixed at zero; no telemetry is time shifted.
Statistics use equal sample weights, type-7 quantiles, population standard deviation and unscaled MAD. Samples/windows may be correlated; counts are not independent observations.
Empty statistics and unrepresentable numerical results are null. Coverage has explicit sample/grid denominators and is not a confidence estimate.
VE values are not interpolated or required for geometric neighborhood membership; missing target corners with positive weight block target lookup.
Eligibility indices, partitions and timestamps are validated. Existing classifier contracts lack session identity, so callers must supply results from the same unchanged session.
Phase A cell support measures training coverage only, not identifiability, correction accuracy, or confidence. No corrections are fitted.
Episodes group whole accepted runs without AFR-error selection; nearby runs may remain correlated. Temporal gaps and embargo do not establish independence.
Partitioning uses fixed full-log eligibility to define episodes, then audits V1 boundaries or recomputes V2 within each partition. Full-log time high-water integrity is retained.
Calibration association and active ECU table/fueling mode require caller confirmation. Source content hashes detect mismatched artifacts, not incorrect calibration association.
Fuel is assumed proportional to interpolated VE with other factors fixed. Closed-loop corrections, injector behavior, sensor bias and unimplemented AFR delay can invalidate predictions.
Effects in unobserved neighboring operating regions are unassessed. V1 categorical fuel-cut limitations remain unchanged.
